t: Introduction and overview — Dodge Power Wagon (1945-1980)
name: Introduction and overview — Dodge Power Wagon (1945-1980) — car record
title: Introduction and overview — Dodge Power Wagon (1945-1980)
description: Introduction and overview of the Dodge Power Wagon (1945-1980): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Dodge Power Wagon was the first civilian 4x4 pickup, derived directly from WWII military trucks. With its flathead/slant sixes and later V8s, it served farms, utilities, and the military for 35 years. The Power Wagon invented the 4x4 pickup category every truck maker now competes in. Baseline facts: American 4x4 pickup 1945-1980; first civilian 4x4 pickup; military-derived..
